description: The runner-side execution object (plan Phase A, "execution object schema"): keys, types, defaults and bounds, the normalization of a legacy flat resources object, and ten validation cases with the exact error messages both runners and both SDKs produce.

schema.meaning: task: one payload run per order; session: the order stays open for inputs
the order duration; the DO request _duration (uint16) and the escrow hours
orders runTasks opens at once, each a DO request with its own enclave
the largest node paid for, in thousandths of a CU; 0 = any node (the escrow is then bounded by CU_MAX_DEFAULT)
margin over the quoted price when the runner sizes maxPricePerCuHour
inputs the dApp expects to send; sizes relayCap as 1 + expectedInputs rows (the etny-sw row plus one etny-so per input); 256 is MAX_SESSION_MESSAGES
keep the session open until the dApp closes it instead of closing after expectedInputs
open a new order on another node when the session expires with inputs pending
renewals allowed; must be >= 1 when renew is true
state commits the dApp expects to relay per order; sizes relayCap as expectedCommits x commitCost; bounded at 100 (the securelocks refuse a run past MAX_COMMITS_PER_TASK = 256 commits)

rules: a missing execution object, or a missing key, takes the default; null is not a value
values are checked after parsing: the SDKs parse EXEC_* .env strings and the EXECUTION block of .config.json into numbers and booleans before validation
unknown keys at any level are an error
the session block is accepted in both modes and applied in mode "session" only, so a configuration written by ecld-init carries every key
checks run in schema order and the first failing check names the error

normalization.rule: a flat resources object keeps taskPrice, cpu, memory, storage, bandwidth and validators; duration moves to execution.durationHours; when both duration and execution.durationHours are given, execution.durationHours wins and duration is dropped

validationCases.name: durationHours below 1
validationCases.error: execution.durationHours must be an integer between 1 and 65535

validationCases.name: durationHours not an integer
validationCases.error: execution.durationHours must be an integer between 1 and 65535

validationCases.name: maxCu negative
validationCases.error: execution.maxCu must be an integer >= 0 (thousandths of a CU, 0 = any node)

validationCases.name: headroomPercent above 100
validationCases.error: execution.headroomPercent must be an integer between 0 and 100

validationCases.name: session.expectedInputs above 256
validationCases.error: execution.session.expectedInputs must be an integer between 1 and 256

validationCases.name: session.renew without renewals
validationCases.error: execution.session.maxRenewals must be >= 1 when execution.session.renew is true

validationCases.name: esr.expectedCommits above 100
validationCases.error: execution.esr.expectedCommits must be an integer between 0 and 100
